user.title: Connect to your Vanderbilt SPC panel
user.description: The panel dials in to Home Assistant over the EDP protocol; it does not work the other way around. Configure the panel under Communications → Reporting → EDP to point at this host, using the receiver id and port below.

data.encryption_key: EDP encryption key (32 hex digits, optional)

data_description.receiver_id: Must match the Receiver ID configured on the panel's EDP entry.
data_description.port: The TCP port Home Assistant will listen on for the panel to dial in to.
data_description.bind: The local address to bind the listener to. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections on any interface.
data_description.encryption_key: Leave blank if EDP encryption is disabled on the panel.

reconfigure.title: Update your Vanderbilt SPC panel connection
reconfigure.description: Changing the port or bind address will restart the listener; the panel must already be configured to redial the new address.

data.encryption_key: EDP encryption key (32 hex digits, optional)

error.invalid_receiver_id: Receiver ID must be a whole number between 0 and 65535.
error.invalid_encryption_key: The encryption key must be exactly 32 hex digits (16 bytes), or left blank.
error.cannot_bind: Could not bind to that address and port. It may already be in use.

abort.already_configured: A receiver is already configured for that bind address and port.

data_description.idle_timeout: Disconnect the panel if it sends nothing for this long. The panel typically polls every ~10 seconds.
data_description.area_refresh_interval: A slower full re-sync of areas/zones to correct for any drift not covered by pushed events.
